# Gabriel Kadiwa

> Portfolio of Gabriel Kadiwa — Fullstack Developer, IT Consultant, Graphic Designer, and Tutor. Retro/pixel-themed single-page portfolio built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

Gabriel is a Computer Science professional experienced in software development, system administration, and IT support, specializing in building scalable systems and leveraging modern technologies for digital transformation. He currently balances several concurrent roles spanning contract engineering, freelance project management, consulting, and running his own web development company.

## Site sections

All sections live on one page (https://gabrielkadiwa.vercel.app) — the links below use anchors to jump to each one.

- [About](https://gabrielkadiwa.vercel.app/#about): Short bio and background.
- [Skills](https://gabrielkadiwa.vercel.app/#skills): Web Development, Mobile Development, Data Science, IT Support & DevOps, Databases.
- [Projects](https://gabrielkadiwa.vercel.app/#projects): Live deployed projects with previews, plus public GitHub repositories.
- [Experience](https://gabrielkadiwa.vercel.app/#experience): Full work history, current and past.
- [Certifications](https://gabrielkadiwa.vercel.app/#certifications): Degree and professional certifications.
- [Pricing](https://gabrielkadiwa.vercel.app/#pricing): Live pricing embedded from Websites and Systems Co, Gabriel's web development company.
- [Contact](https://gabrielkadiwa.vercel.app/#contact): Contact form, email, phone, and social links.
